records.title: NSF MathSci: Statistics
records.action: Prepare a Statistics concept; confirm panel timing with Stat@nsf.gov.
records.conditions: US universities eligible; no PI or proposal-count limits in solicitation. Foundational statistical contribution required.
records.timing: Target date derived from second Monday in December; proposals accepted anytime.
records.budgetBasis: Range of budgets and durations; no per-project cap specified in reviewed solicitation.
records.concept: Theory of communication-efficient inference, heterogeneous-site estimation, and valid inference with AI-derived surrogates.
records.overlap: Distinguish foundational theory from deliverables already funded by NIH and PCORI.
records.evidence: Current solicitation and Statistics program page rechecked. December 14 follows the second-Monday-in-December target rule; proposals accepted anytime.

records.title: NSF Future CoRe
records.action: Check submission-count limit and choose CISE program. Rolling submissions remain open; next published recurring target is February 4, 2027.
records.officialTitle: Computer and Information Science and Engineering: Future Computing Research (Future CoRe)
records.conditions: US universities eligible. A person may appear as PI/co-PI/senior-key personnel on at most 2 proposals in any consecutive 12 months under this solicitation; Yong's count unknown.
records.timing: First Thursday in February; proposals accepted anytime. This is a target, not a closing date.
records.budgetBasis: Maximum total project budget; up to 4 years. Distinct from direct-cost-only NIH/PCORI figures.
records.concept: Foundational algorithms for federated learning, trustworthy medical NLP or computable evidence graphs, with a computing collaborator.
records.overlap: Separate algorithmic contributions from ClinEX/PANDA implementation milestones.
records.evidence: Current solicitation rechecked. September target passed without closing rolling acceptance; February 4 follows the published first-Thursday rule.

records.title: NIH Parent R21
records.action: Scope a genuinely new pilot and confirm the intended IC's interests.
records.officialTitle: NIH Exploratory/Developmental Research Project Grant (Parent R21 Clinical Trial Not Allowed)
records.conditions: Penn eligible. NLM, NIA, NIMH, NEI and NCATS appear as participants. Project must be exploratory; no NIH-defined trial.
records.budgetBasis: Total direct costs over 2 years; no more than $200,000 in one year.
records.concept: Pilot a new multimodal surrogate-validation or federated synthetic-data method before a larger R01.
records.overlap: Do not repackage current ROP R21, PANDA or AI-ADRD aims as exploratory work.
records.evidence: Current NOFO and participation notices rechecked, including NCATS July 16 and NHLBI March 26, 2026. October 16 new-application deadline; two-year direct-cost limits confirmed.

records.title: NIH Parent R01
records.action: Choose a distinct concept and relevant IC; assess October readiness or next February cycle.
records.sponsor: NIH (NLM / NIA / NIMH and participating ICs)
records.officialTitle: NIH Research Project Grant (Parent R01 Clinical Trial Not Allowed)
records.conditions: Penn is an eligible private university. Select a participating IC and confirm scientific fit. No NIH-defined clinical trial.
records.budgetBasis: No overall cap in parent NOFO; budget must reflect needs. Confirm IC-specific limits.
records.concept: Generalizable federated inference or surrogate validation, with an application outside existing funded aims. NIH AI topic explicitly supports cross-disease methods through parent routes.
records.overlap: High potential overlap with PANDA, ClinEX, AI-ADRD and GLP-1 R01. Compare specific aims before selecting a concept.
records.evidence: Current NOFO and related notices rechecked, including NCATS participation added May 27, 2026 and removal of AIDS-specific dates. October 5 is a new-application date.

records.title: NSF AI Datasets
records.action: Select an accessible existing dataset and community partners; assess Impact versus Planning scope and NSF scientific fit for November 4.
records.officialTitle: Unlocking Dataset Value for AI-Enabled Scientific Discovery (AI Datasets)
records.conditions: US universities eligible; no PI/proposal-count caps. Single lead with subawards. Requires existing datasets and credible governance/access; new data collection is out of scope. PennCIL data rights and community partners need confirmation.
records.budgetBasis: Total project caps: Impact $2m; Flagship $5m; Planning $200,000. Three years for Impact/Flagship; planning duration not separately verified.
records.concept: Validate and harmonize existing multisite datasets for AI analysis, with error-aware metadata and privacy-preserving quality checks.
records.overlap: Potential overlap with ReCARDO harmonization, ClinEX metadata and PANDA. Separate community dataset, deliverables and costs from existing awards.
records.evidence: Official solicitation read; no LOI or preliminary proposal required. Posted July 21, 2026; first added to this tracker September 22, not newly announced this review.

records.title: NLM/NIMH Personal Health Informatics
records.action: Check whether a patient-facing concept is feasible; confirm fit with NLM/NIMH before developing aims.
records.officialTitle: Personal Health Informatics for Delivering Actionable Insights to Individuals (R01 Clinical Trial Optional)
records.conditions: Penn eligible. Must deliver actionable personal-health insights; a researcher-only analytics tool is insufficient. Clinical trials optional.
records.budgetBasis: Expected annual direct-cost maximum, not total award. Up to 4 years.
records.concept: Patient-facing risk interpretation using validated multimodal phenotypes. Requires participatory design and a personal-health use case.
records.overlap: Related to IMPACT-MH/ClinEX but a distinct patient-facing intervention would need justification.
records.evidence: Current NOFO and corrected-date notice rechecked. October 5, 2026 is the last listed new-application deadline; November 5 is for renewal/resubmission, not a new application.

records.title: PCORI Methods 2027 C1
records.action: Prepare a concept and engagement plan now; review final PFA November 17.
records.officialTitle: Improving Methods for Conducting Patient-Centered Comparative Clinical Effectiveness Research — Cycle 1 2027
records.conditions: Penn can apply. LOI acceptance/invitation needed for full proposal. Final posted PFA must be reviewed when it opens.
records.timing: 5 pm Eastern; opening November 17 at 9 am Eastern
records.budgetBasis: Announced maximum direct costs; recheck final PFA at opening.
records.concept: Plan a new patient-centered measurement or federated validation method with an explicit CER use case.
records.overlap: Compare with existing PCORI federated TTE award; separate scientific aims and costs.
records.evidence: Official upcoming announcement read directly. Opens November 17 at 9 am Eastern; January 6 LOI and May 4 full application at 5 pm Eastern, invitation required. Recheck final PFA at opening.

records.title: PCORI Broad Pragmatic 2027 C1
records.action: Identify clinical lead, patient partners and candidate CRNs; verify final PFA November 17.
records.conditions: Penn eligible; clinical partners, data access and engagement needed. Full application by invitation. Final category requirements pending review at opening.
records.concept: Build a clinical CER partnership using PennCIL's network trial-emulation and phenotype-validation expertise.
records.overlap: Develop a comparison distinct from current GLP-1/mental-health and AD repurposing awards.
records.evidence: Official indexed upcoming announcement rechecked; direct page returned 403. November 17 opening, January 6 LOI, May 4 invited full application; budget categories confirmed. Final PFA still upcoming.

records.title: PCORI Digital Health 2027 C1
records.action: Identify a validated digital-health intervention and clinical CER partners; review final PFA at November opening.
records.officialTitle: Harnessing Digital Health Technologies To Support Patient-Centered Comparative Clinical Effectiveness Research — Cycle 1 2027
records.conditions: Penn eligible in principle. Requires clinical CER using established digital health technologies, completed product/algorithm validation, patient engagement and primary clinical outcomes. Full application by invitation; methods-only development is nonresponsive.
records.budgetBasis: Announced maximum direct costs; shorter projects encouraged.
records.concept: Compare established digital-health approaches for a concrete clinical condition; PennCIL contributes validated outcome measurement and heterogeneity analysis.
records.overlap: Potential relation to IMPACT-MH measurement; needs a separate clinical question and team.
records.evidence: Official upcoming announcement read. Existing efficacy or widespread use and completed development/validation are required. November 17 opening, January 6 LOI, May 4 invited full application; announced caps remain subject to final PFA.

records.title: Smart Health successor watch
records.action: Watch for successor to NSF 25-542; do not apply against an old annual date.
records.officialTitle: Smart Health and Biomedical Research in the Era of Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Data Science
records.conditions: Reassess eligibility under a new solicitation. Current program page has no upcoming due dates.
records.concept: Strong thematic match for convergent federated inference and health AI.
records.overlap: Compare future topics with PANDA, ClinEX and clinical-methods awards.
records.evidence: Official program page rechecked: waiting for new publication. No upcoming due date or successor solicitation verified; thematic relevance alone does not establish an open call.

records.title: NLM Informatics R01 (expired)
records.action: Use the current parent R01 route or verified successor; monitor NLM updates.
records.officialTitle: NLM Research Grants in Biomedical Informatics and Data Science (R01 Clinical Trial Optional)
records.conditions: Expired notice; current eligibility is not applicable.
records.budgetBasis: Historical caps omitted to avoid treating this as available funding.
records.concept: High thematic relevance to informatics and generalizable methods.
records.evidence: Official NOFO remains EXPIRED, effective March 6, 2026. No reopening verified; use an appropriate current parent route.

records.title: PCORI Methods 2026 C3
records.action: For an already submitted LOI, confirm the October 14 notification and invitation before using the January 12 full deadline. Otherwise prepare for 2027 C1.
records.officialTitle: Improving Methods for Conducting Patient-Centered Comparative Clinical Effectiveness Research — Cycle 3 2026
records.conditions: New-LOI window closed. January full application is available only after LOI acceptance and invitation; patient/stakeholder engagement and CER relevance required.
records.budgetBasis: Maximum direct costs, not total program pool.
records.concept: Multisite outcome measurement, synthetic RWD validation or AI-assisted CER inference fit the current methods priorities.
records.overlap: Very close to ME-2024C3-42660 and GLP-1 causal-methods R01; establish new estimands or validation problems.
records.evidence: Official indexed announcement: LOIs under review; September 9 LOI, October 14 notification, January 12 full application by invitation. Direct page returned 403. Closed here to new applicants.

records.title: AHRQ AI Safety R18 (expired)
records.action: Monitor AHRQ for a replacement; do not rely on the old November 2026 expiration.
records.officialTitle: Examining the Impact of Artificial Intelligence on Healthcare Safety (R18)
records.conditions: No further applications accepted under this NOFO.
records.concept: Potential future fit for clinical AI safety and error measurement.
records.overlap: Related to phenotype validation and applied AI evaluation.
records.evidence: Official early-expiration notice effective March 17, 2026 rechecked. AHRQ funding index lists no open program announcements at review; no replacement verified.

records.title: PCORI Broad Pragmatic 2026 C3
records.action: For an already submitted LOI, confirm the October 14 notification and invitation before using the January 12 full deadline. Otherwise prepare for 2027 C1.
records.conditions: New-LOI window closed. January full application requires an accepted LOI and invitation. Category 3 requires at least 2 PCORnet CRNs; clinical partners and engagement are essential.
records.budgetBasis: Direct costs: Category 1 up to $5m; Categories 2/3 up to $12m.
records.concept: Patient-centered comparative study of diabetes/metabolic therapies or mental health outcomes. Methods-only development is nonresponsive.
records.overlap: A GLP-1 comparison may overlap the active NIMH award. Needs a distinct clinical question and patient-centered outcomes.
records.evidence: Official announcement read: LOIs under review; September 9 LOI, October 14 notification, January 12 full application by invitation. Closed here to new applicants.

records.action: Watch the next round; no future deadline is assumed.
